evidence.claim: Syncro Group copre tutto il processo della plastica, dal dosaggio all'estrusione al riciclo, ed è presente in Italia, USA, India, Brasile e Cina.
evidence.quote: SYNCRO GROUP provides a comprehensive portfolio of advanced technologies designed to optimize every stage of the plastics production process , from raw material storage, conveying, dosing and mixing to extrusion automation, quality control, material recovery and recycling. || With an international presence spanning Italy, the USA, India, Brazil and China, and a direct commercial and technical network covering more than 50 countries || providing manufacturers, research institutes and universities with advanced solutions to test new materials, develop innovative formulations and optimize production processes
